scope: Official front/rear/GameCube-side diagrams and RVL-003 front photograph compared with before/after CAD views; local fitted values and unmeasured shell profile limits are retained. Reference imagery remains local.

findings.before: Overlong 70.3 mm SD cover, short/wide controls, and Wii wordmark kept horizontal after the console was laid down.
findings.after: Cover width fitted to 61.5 mm, narrower/taller power/reset/eject caps with corresponding holes, and the wordmark rotated with the original faceplate.
findings.basis: Official front diagram normalized by the 157 mm axis; local dimensions and font shapes remain estimates. Main slot location and control ordering retained.

findings.before: Ten tall exhaust slits, 17 mm USB center spacing and a pale AV connector surround.
findings.after: Twenty-five square exhaust cells, 8.5 mm USB center spacing, dark AV surround and orange sensor-bar keying.
findings.basis: Opening topology and color roles are documented; cell size 6.2 mm, pitch 6.8 mm, USB spacing and numerical RGB values are diagram fits. Existing fan center is retained.

findings.finding: Side, controller-port order with port 1 nearest the front, and memory slots behind the controller bank agree with the manual. Covers are hidden for comparison; exact local slot and hinge dimensions remain unmeasured.

findings.before: Main controls were about 7-10 mm too low in the photograph fit; twenty-one speaker holes; numerical player marks below the lamps; no bottom Wii wordmark.
findings.after: Repositioned key/plunger/contact stacks, speaker and lamps; eighteen graded holes; one-to-four dot patterns above the lamps and bottom Wii lettering.
findings.basis: Original product photograph normalized to 36.2 x 148 mm. All local positions, hole sizes and the replacement font remain fitted approximations; the schematic EEPROM package moves 3 mm within the board to clear the corrected speaker.

findings.finding: Add the documented red SYNC button with a schematic PCB-mounted switch and an integral lanyard passage. No strap or jacket added.
Public gross console envelope retained. Local longitudinal Remote rear curvature, B-trigger contour and detailed console molding have not been measured and remain reconstruction limits.
